guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low (active low reset), tlram_rdata is asynchronously cleared to 0.
On a rising clock edge when rst_ni is high, if tlram_req is high and tlram_we is low (read request), tlram_rdata is updated with conv_endian32(tlram_rdata_endian, endian_swap_i).

assumptions.claim: tlram_rdata_endian and endian_swap_i must be valid and stable at the rising clock edge when tlram_req & ~tlram_we is true.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect or corrupted data captured into tlram_rdata.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni must be glitch-free and released synchronously to clk_i to avoid metastable reset or partial register clearing.
assumptions.risk: tlram_rdata may be corrupted or not fully reset.

uncertain_points.claim: The function conv_endian32 is defined elsewhere; its byte-order reversal correctness and width handling must be verified for the data type of tlram_rdata.
uncertain_points.risk: Wrong endian conversion could silently corrupt the read data.

uncertain_points.claim: The block assumes tlram_rdata_endian holds valid, stable read data at the posedge of clk_i when the read handshake fires. Any timing misalignment or asynchronous RAM may cause stale/corrupt capture.
uncertain_points.risk: Stale or garbled data written to tlram_rdata.
